description: Office of the Public Service Commission - Delegation of Powers by the Public Service Commission in terms of Article 57(1) of the Constitution
reasoning: This gazette notification involves the delegation of powers by the Public Service Commission regarding public service administration matters, specifically transfers, appointments, promotions, and disciplinary control of public officers. It falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) as it deals with public sector administration, service conditions, and administrative instructions rather than government structure/personnel changes or other specialized categories.
